![Daylight UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/main/screenshots/logo-banner.png)

[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/dayightt/DaylightUI?include_prereleases&style=flat-square&label=release&color=766ee0)](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/releases/latest)
![Built for WoW: Forever](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20for-WoW%3A%20Forever-f67a44?style=flat-square)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/discord-join-5865f2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/eeSYZDd6ar)

**A complete UI suite for WoW: Forever.** Soft, modern, and one look across everything.

[Download on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/daylightui) | [GitHub releases](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/releases/latest) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/eeSYZDd6ar)

---

Daylight UI replaces the unit frames, action bars, nameplates, buffs, chat, bags, tooltips, quest tracker and most of the game's windows with one calm, consistent look. Every part is its own addon, so you can switch off any module and keep the rest. Install it from CurseForge, log in, and click **Install Daylight UI** on the popup. `/dui` opens the options.

| Addon | What it is |
|---|---|
| `DaylightUI` | The core. Every module needs it. Also the options, the setup guide, and the restyled character, spellbook, NPC, profession, mail, group finder and social windows |
| `DaylightUI_UnitFrames` | Player, target, focus, pet, party and raid frames, cast bars, swing timers, click-casting |
| `DaylightUI_ActionBars` | Action bars and the Cooldown Manager |
| `DaylightUI_Nameplates` | Enemy and friendly nameplates |
| `DaylightUI_Buffs` | Grouped buffs and debuffs |
| `DaylightUI_InfoPanel` | XP bar, damage and threat meters, minimap |
| `DaylightUI_Quests` | Quest tracker and journal |
| `DaylightUI_Chat` | Chat window |
| `DaylightUI_Bags` | Bags and bank |
| `DaylightUI_Tooltip` | Tooltips |
| `DaylightUI_Skins` | The game's other windows and the world map |
| `DaylightUI_QoL` | Small quality-of-life helpers |

Making a plugin? [`API.md`](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/API.md) covers how to match the look and build on Daylight UI's frames.

---

# Contributing

**Bug fixes are welcome any time. Before you build a feature, ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/eeSYZDd6ar) first.** Daylight UI is big, and every feature has to be kept working through game patches. Some good ideas still won't fit, and it's better to find that out before you spend a weekend on it.

Thanks for wanting to help. Translations are welcome too: the strings live in `Locales/`. Setup, tests and the technical details are in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Adding features

Daylight UI has one vision: **simple, smooth and immersive.** Fewer things on screen, each one easy to read. Everything moves softly instead of popping. The game world stays the star. A feature that doesn't serve that won't go into the main addon, however good it is on its own. That rules out busy displays, walls of numbers, options that only make sense to a few players, and anything that pulls your eyes off the game.

**Big features should be plugins.** If you want to add something large (a new window, a new kind of tracker, a whole system), build it as a plugin: your own addon that runs on top of Daylight UI and looks like part of it. Plugins can put pieces on Daylight UI's frames, paint them, get their own section in the options window, and keep their settings in Daylight UI's profiles. Start with the [plugin guide in `API.md`](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/API.md#a-plugin-of-your-own) and its [quick start](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/API.md#quick-start). Name it `Your Plugin (DaylightUI Plugin)`, in its `.toc` Title and wherever you upload it.

Small features that fit the vision are welcome as pull requests. Ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/eeSYZDd6ar) before you start, so you know it fits.

## Pull request or plugin?

Not everything belongs in Daylight UI itself. A lot of ideas work better as a plugin. [`API.md`](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/API.md) shows how to find Daylight UI's frames, put your own pieces on them, paint them, add your settings to its options pages, skin another addon's window, and fill a data text slot.

**Send a pull request when:**
- something is broken, or looks or behaves wrong;
- the base game has something Daylight UI is missing;
- it's a translation, or a small improvement nearly every player would want;
- the API is missing a hook your plugin needs (adding the hook is a welcome PR).

**Make a plugin when:**
- it's for one class, role or playstyle (a healer layout, a class resource, a PvP tracker);
- it's a matter of taste: a different look, extra text on the frames, your own colors or fonts;
- it ties Daylight UI to another addon, or skins one;
- it's a big feature, one that was turned down here, or one you want to ship on your own schedule;
- it's a profile pack or a preset for your guild or stream.

Plugins need no permission, aren't held up by review, and keep working across updates as long as they stick to the calls in `API.md`. They can't include copies of Daylight UI's code or art, and they must stay free: donations are welcome, but nothing can be locked behind a payment, subscription or early access. See [`LICENSE`](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/LICENSE).

## What every change has to meet

1. **It feels better to play.** That is the whole point of Daylight UI. For a raider or PvP player: instant, clear at a glance mid-fight, never in the way, never laggy. For a casual player: calm, pretty, and good without touching the options. If something only makes sense in code and not in play, it doesn't go in.
2. **Fight information never waits.** Animations are welcome, but anything a fight needs (health, casts, cooldowns, threat) shows at once.
3. **No cost when idle.** Nothing new runs every frame while nothing is happening. Use events, throttles, or hide the frame. `tests/test_lag.lua` checks this.
4. **Safe in combat.** No taint, no hooks on the game's own frames, protected frames only touched out of combat, and secret values never compared, added up or tested in an `if`. `tests/test_guards.lua` and `tests/test_secrets.lua` catch most mistakes.
5. **Good defaults.** A new option's default has to suit every class, role, group size and screen size. Plenty of players never open the options.
6. **WoW: Forever only.** Interface 16001, which runs on the modern client with the modern addon rules. Code written for older Classic clients usually doesn't apply.

## Look and code style

- Lua 5.1, no `goto`. Plain ASCII in code and comments.
- Match the code around you. Before building something, find where Daylight UI already does the same thing and do it the same way.
- Every button, tab, switch, slider, input, menu and scroll bar comes from `Options/Widgets.lua`. Never hand-build a control or use the game's templates.
- Frames wear `Style.Shell`. Bars are gradients.
- Text sizes come from `Style.SIZE` and text colors from `Style.INK` or `Style.Accent()`. No typed-in colors, no plain gray text.
- Calm text: values white, sentences soft white, labels tan. Color only the one or two words a glance needs. A number that matters gets the accent.
- Things move. Anything that appears, leaves, resizes or fills eases there with `Motion`, at one of its three speeds.
- Every string a player sees goes through the locale table (`L["..."]`).
- Fix the cause. Hiding a problem, switching a feature off, or defaulting it off isn't a fix.
- Keep comments short. Say why, not what.

`tests/test_hygiene.lua` checks most of the look rules for you.

## Pull requests

- One fix or feature per PR, with the smallest diff that does it.
- Before and after screenshots for anything visible.
- Run the tests (`luajit tests/run.lua --par`) and say what you checked in game.
- Fill in the PR checklist honestly. "Not applicable" is a fine answer.
- Leave `CHANGELOG.md` and `PatchNotes.lua` alone. Release notes are written at release time.

## AI coding tools

AI tools are fine to use, but the PR is yours and so is every line in it.

- Check how the game actually behaves instead of trusting the tool's memory. `luajit tools/api.lua <name>` shows a function's arguments, whether it returns secret values, and where Daylight UI already uses it. The game's own UI code is in [Gethe/wow-ui-source](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source) on the `forever` branch.
- Only original code. Don't paste in code from other addons, and check what the tool wrote for anything copied.
- Reuse the helpers that already exist instead of writing new copies.
- Keep the comments short. Long, chatty comments and notes about how the code was written get removed in review.
- Test it in game. AI code that passes tests can still feel wrong in play.

## License

Daylight UI is source-available, not open source. You can fork the repo to send pull requests, and plugins and profile packs are welcome without asking (free for everyone; donations are fine, paywalls aren't). Re-uploading it or reusing its code or art elsewhere needs permission. By sending a pull request you agree to the contribution terms in [`LICENSE`](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/blob/main/LICENSE): you keep the copyright to your work and give Daylight UI a license to use it.

## Credits

Spanish translation by Narian. Simplified Chinese translation by Hwtaps.

Ships with Expressway Free and other free fonts, each under its own license (see `Media/fonts`). The optional Fabled class icon styles come from [Jiberish Fabled Icons](https://github.com/Repooc/ElvUI_JiberishIcons) and only show if you install that addon; Daylight UI doesn't include them and isn't made or endorsed by JiberishUI.

# DaylightUI 2.4.3

Bar animations that run either way, angled ends you can set on every bar, and a mailbox and spellbook that do everything the game's own do.

## New
- Bar animations: Flip direction: any bar animation can run the other way along the bar
- Slant angle: Set how far angled ends lean on nameplates, the loot feed, meters, the data bar, the breath bar and boss timers. Unit frames' now goes up to 100%
- Spellbook: Hide passive spells: a switch at the bottom of the spellbook lists only the spells you cast
- Proc Alerts: The Overpower alert lights up after a dodge in Defensive or Berserker Stance too, so you know when to swap
- Cast bars: Target, focus and party cast bars outside their frame can have their own border, corners and shadow

## Changed
- Bags: The bags' own "Compare with what you wear" switch is gone: the one under Tooltip decides for every item
- Unit frames: A cast bar or swing timer docked to the personal display keeps its own look and spot, and moves with the display as you zoom

## Fixed
- Mailbox: The mailbox does what the game's does again: letter previews, Shift-click links, COD, keeping a copy, reporting spam, and the Send page's keys and name suggestions
- Spellbook: The spellbook and talents do what the game's do: Alt-click self-cast, Shift-P for pet spells, autocast marks, search by what a spell does, drag talents onto your bars
- Quests: Quests started from an item show at the top of the tracker again, and quest item buttons link, light up and stay like the game's
- Social: Whispering a friend added by character name reaches them again, and the social tabs no longer run into your BattleTag
- Unit frames: The personal display comes back when you mouse over it, like every other part of the UI
- Proc Alerts: Proc alerts and the Molten, Cinders and Slosh bar animations no longer show as green boxes for some players
- Action bars: Long item cooldowns (like the Salt Shaker) show the same time on your bars as in your bags
- Cooldown Manager: A recast glow turns off once its debuff is gone
- Auction House: The Sell tab lists other sellers' auctions by the price you see
- Professions: Clicking the tab you're already on no longer closes the profession window
- Cast bars: A target or focus cast bar above or below its frame leans at the ends like the frame
- Little touches: The minimap's quest areas fade with the map, the quest tracker's hover highlight sits evenly round the text (thanks Naerian), quests asking for gold show what you have, and the window swap link reads right

## Thanks to

- Bug Quest tracker: the hover wash has uneven room around the text by [Naerian](https://github.com/Naerian) ([#211](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/211))
- Turn a Cooldown Manager recast glow off once its debuff is gone by [matthttam](https://github.com/matthttam) ([#236](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/236))
- Sort the Sell tab's "On the Auction House now" list by the price it shows by [matthttam](https://github.com/matthttam) ([#237](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/237))
- Keep the profession window open on a second click of a tab by [matthttam](https://github.com/matthttam) ([#238](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/238))
- Size the game window's swap link once that window shows by [matthttam](https://github.com/matthttam) ([#239](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/239))

**Support Daylight UI**
Daylight UI is free for everyone. If you enjoy it and want to help it grow, every bit helps, and thank you to everyone who already has!
[☕ Tip on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/daylightui) · [💜 Become a VIP on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/DaylightUI)

# DaylightUI 2.4.2

XP orbs that stream into your XP bar, missing buffs shown as icons above you, and a character window that does everything the game's own window does.

## New
- Info Panel: XP orbs: gaining experience sends a ring of orbs flying into your XP bar
- Buffs: Missing buffs show as icons above you: raid buffs, class buffs, poisons, food, scrolls and more. Click one to cast it. Set them up under Buffs > Missing buffs

## Changed
- Unit frames: The druid resource bars are gone. In bear and cat form, a mana strip on your power bar shows your mana instead
- Leader tools: When you aren't the leader, the card shows only the markers. World markers glow so they're easy to tell apart

## Fixed
- Bags: Hovering Disenchant after Shift-clicking it no longer throws an error
- Info Panel: The data bar's text color setting works again
- Bar animations: Embers uses your chosen colors instead of always orange
- Group finder: Typing /who opens the Who tab
- Chat: Clicking a Battle.net friend's name in a whisper works again
- Character: The Skills, Currency, Statistics and PvP tabs now do everything the game's own window does (skill details, currency links and caps, live stats, season countdown)
- Character: Right-drag your character to move it in view, gear you've enchanted glows, and Ctrl-click a set item to try it on

**Support Daylight UI**
Daylight UI is free for everyone. If you enjoy it and want to help it grow, every bit helps, and thank you to everyone who already has!
[☕ Tip on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/daylightui) · [💜 Become a VIP on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/DaylightUI)

# DaylightUI 2.4.1

Proc alerts redone as living flame, spell costs on your action buttons, icon borders per frame, and lower nameplates on new profiles.

## New
- Nameplates: Levels on friendly nameplates are no longer gray when they're far below you: they show in the player's class color or the NPC's reaction color, or white, your accent or a color you pick
- Proc Alerts: Proc alerts move like real flame now: each flare whips out in a spray of sparks, flickers, sheds embers and burns away. Every animation was redone, Strike is a new one, and each alert can turn its embers off
- Action bars: Spell costs on your buttons: each spell's mana, rage or energy cost, turning red when you're short. Turn it on in the setup guide or under Action Bars > Text
- Unit frames: Icon borders: set the border round each frame's buff and debuff icons on its own, its thickness, dispel type colors or one color, plain, accent, class or your own color on buffs, and the dispel glow (each frame's Auras tab)
- Quests: The quest tracker can show its All / This zone filter as words under the title (Quests > Filter under the title, thanks Ángel)

## Changed
- Nameplates: New profiles put nameplates lower, right over heads instead of floating high above them. Your own profiles keep their height (Nameplates > Plates up / down, which now goes lower too)

## Fixed
- Mailbox: Auction house letters in the inbox show the item and whether it sold, expired or was won, and the days left no longer get cut off (thanks Jensry)
- Group finder: Groups of up to ten (like Upper Blackrock Spire) show every member's name and class again when you hover or click them; bigger raids show how many of each class are in
- Damage numbers: Picking Game default for damage numbers puts back how they fly, even when another addon had changed it
- Quests: With a controller, Show on map in the quest log can be reached with the D-pad
- Proc Alerts: Missile Barrage no longer lights up for Clearcasting when the Clearcasting alert is turned off
- Bags: Clean up toward the end turns on with one click, stays on when you move your bags, and really packs your items into the last slots
- Gold: Gold, bags and item counts leave out your characters on another ruleset, like an RP PvP character on a PvE one (log in on each character once so it's sorted)
- Unit frames: With a portrait on, the health and power bars no longer run under it, so a nearly empty bar looks nearly empty and centered health text sits in the middle
- Action bars: A spell cast through a macro lights up its button when it procs
- Proc Alerts: Fingers of Frost lights up again whenever it procs, in a fight too
- Unit frames: With a controller, joining a group or zoning no longer throws a 'secret boolean' error from the party and raid frames
- Bags: No more error at login with Pawn and an addon like Caerdon Wardrobe on, and the upgrade search works with them
- Unit frames: Add piece on a frame's texts can add other addons' texts too (thanks illepic)
- Translations: Every missing Spanish text translated (thanks Ángel), and the newest settings in Simplified Chinese (thanks Levis)

## Thanks to

- Feature Quest tracker: an option to show the All / This zone filter under the title by [Naerian](https://github.com/Naerian) ([#210](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/210))
- locale(zhCN): update Simplified Chinese translations by [levis0792](https://github.com/levis0792) ([#216](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/216))
- Translation Spanish: the 432 texts missing from esES by [Naerian](https://github.com/Naerian) ([#217](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/217))
- locale(zhCN): update Simplified Chinese translations by [levis0792](https://github.com/levis0792) ([#218](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/218))
- Let Add piece add plugin texts by [illepic](https://github.com/illepic) ([#219](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/219))
- Show the item and its fate on auction house letters in the inbox by [Jensry](https://github.com/Jensry) ([#220](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/220))

**Support Daylight UI**
Daylight UI is free for everyone. If you enjoy it and want to help it grow, every bit helps, and thank you to everyone who already has!

# DaylightUI 2.4.0

Seven new bar animations, choose which part of a unit frame draws on top, bar ends that lean either way, and new speech bubbles.

## New
- Bar animations: Seven new bar animations: Daybreak, Pixel Sparks, Pixel Blaze, Pixel Arc, Slosh, Molten and Cinders
- Info Panel: The experience and reputation bars can wear a bar animation too
- Unit frames: Layers: choose which part of a unit frame draws on top, or Bring forward and Send back in unlock mode (thanks Blukraken)
- Angled bars: Each end of an angled bar can be straight or lean either way, on every angled bar
- Speech bubbles: A sleek new look with a cut corner and a colored line
- Other addons: When another addon does a job Daylight UI does (Platynator, Baganator, Prat...), one box at login lets you pick which to keep
- Proc Alerts: An animation speed slider for each alert
- Test mode: An Auras tick hides the sample buffs and debuffs

## Fixed
- Proc Alerts: Infusion of Light, Redoubt, Vengeance, Nature's Grace and Unsealed Wrath light up, and Missile Barrage stays when Clearcasting procs
- Proc Alerts: Every alert animation looks different and keeps moving, instead of Impact and Flash going still
- Cooldown Manager: Buffs set to show only when missing stay hidden when another player's copy is on you
- Cooldown Manager: Placed proc buffs show again, and the game's own icons no longer block clicks
- Loot rolls: Loot roll cards no longer pile on top of each other when three or more items drop
- Bags: Class reagents sort into Reagents, and no blue squares or gaps stay behind after selling
- Chat: Whispers from the group finder or friends list type right away, and controller hints show once
- Quests: Dragging a zone is smooth, the list lines up with the minimap's frame, and long objectives wrap in tooltips
- Tooltips: Rich tooltips no longer hide TSM's vendor prices
- Unit frames: Bar animations show your chosen bar texture, and the personal display comes back after an attack dismounts you
- Party frames: Picking party members with the D-pad no longer shows an empty box
- Nameplates: Big defensives no longer shows ordinary buffs like Blessing of Kings on enemy players
- Little touches: No bright squares on the dimmed map, the map's quest count no longer hides under the search box, the friends window status row stays in place, no guild window error in dungeons, recent allies in class colors, cleaner portrait edges, and leader chat tags in Chinese and other non-Latin languages (thanks Levis)
- Translations: The newest settings in Simplified Chinese (thanks Levis)

## Thanks to

- Layers: choose which part of a unit frame draws on top by [PinnoWasHere](https://github.com/PinnoWasHere) ([#174](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/174))
- Give leader chat lines a native tag on non-Latin clients by [levis0792](https://github.com/levis0792) ([#181](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/181))
- CDM: keep a placed proc buff showing that the game's item can't see (2.2.5 regression) by [PinnoWasHere](https://github.com/PinnoWasHere) ([#187](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/187))
- CDM: leave the game's items click-through, with tooltips by Show tooltips by [PinnoWasHere](https://github.com/PinnoWasHere) ([#190](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/190))
- Bug Recent allies never got their class: use C_CreatureInfo.GetClassInfo by [Naerian](https://github.com/Naerian) ([#206](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/206))
- Feature Quest tooltips: level and zone apart, the reward under its heading by [Naerian](https://github.com/Naerian) ([#209](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/209))
- locale(zhCN): update Simplified Chinese translations by [levis0792](https://github.com/levis0792) ([#212](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/212))

# DaylightUI 2.3.0

Proc Alerts light up around you when a proc is ready, quest zones in your own order, and the bags, bank, vendor and quest window do everything the game's own do.

## New
- Proc Alerts: A painted flare around your character when a proc like Clearcasting or Overpower is ready. If you already use Daylight UI, a welcome page shows you one to turn on
- Quests: Drag zones in the quest tracker into your own order, or sort them A to Z
- Tooltips: Design mode on the Tooltips page: arrange, group or hide a card's pieces, plus more card choices
- Auction House: Alt-click a bag item to put it on the Sell tab
- Mailbox: Space collects all your mail when the dialogue keys are on
- Plugins: Other addons can follow your proc alerts and light flares of their own: daylightui.com/plugins

## Changed
- Action bars: Show empty buttons covers the action bars only: the game always hid the pet bar's empty slots

## Fixed
- Bags and bank: Everything the game's own bag and bank do: pick up gold, bag filters, currencies, account bank, controller buttons
- Vendor: Dropping an item from your bags on the vendor sells it instead of buying something
- Vendor and trainer: Everything the game's own windows do: compares without Shift, repair one item, guild repair, next spell picked
- Quests: The talk window shows every reward and detail the game's quest window does, compared with your gear
- Quests: Questie icons no longer flicker on hover, and its Hide untracked option stays off
- Windows: Escape closes Daylight UI's small windows and dropdowns in a fight too, like the game's own
- Chat: Whisper buttons in the friends and group finder windows work without chat errors; Battle.net whispers follow a tab's Whispers switch
- Professions: Shift compares a recipe's item with your gear again, and the rogue poison perk works
- Nameplates: Big defensives show on enemy players in PvP, and friendly name nudges work on plates without a health bar
- Cooldown Manager: No more another character's spells when two of yours share a first name
- Unit frames: The power number stays hidden under a cast bar, and a moved cast bar stays on top of a faded frame
- Setup guide: A full list of Edit Mode layouts no longer stops the setup guide at every login
- Minimap: The clock opens the alarm and stopwatch again, and quest areas fade away with the minimap
- Guild: Clicking a name in the guild roster opens their details again
- Auction House: No more stutter when hovering items, while search results come in, or during a full scan
- Group finder: Your new listing shows on Find a group right away, without pressing Refresh
- General: Little touches: Nighthaven flight timer, steady item compares, full camera distance, clean portrait rings, link X on the card (thanks Ángel)
- Translations: The newest settings in Simplified Chinese (thanks Levis)

## Thanks to

- Bug Put a clicked quest link's X on the tooltip card's corner by [Naerian](https://github.com/Naerian) ([#177](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/177))
- locale(zhCN): update Simplified Chinese translations by [levis0792](https://github.com/levis0792) ([#188](https://github.com/dayightt/DaylightUI/pull/188))
